title: fix: app pre-review reads the README of a submitted repo folder
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: App pre-review now reads the README in a submitted GitHub repository folder and limits code search to that folder, rather than checking the repository root. This prevents folder-based apps with a badge in their own README from being incorrectly marked APP-NEEDS-INFO; plain repository URLs still use the root README. The checked folder is included in the review evidence. A folder-URL regression test was added, and PR checks now run test_review_agent.py.
